dependency_type_legend.A: semantic/runtime: Active builder, projection, retrieval, or storage path reads the stage.
dependency_type_legend.B: validation-only: Validator or test enforces a stage-specific/frozen contract.
dependency_type_legend.C: provenance/hash-only: Manifest, input hash, selection hash, or later audit preserves the stage.
dependency_type_legend.D: documentation-only: Documentation or archived design material references the stage.
dependency_type_legend.E: no live reference: Exact repository-wide live-reference scan found no consumer.

category_legend.ACTIVE_INPUT: Consumed by an active algorithm or projection.
category_legend.CURRENT_BASELINE: Current protected baseline used by active/upstream validation.
category_legend.FROZEN_PROVENANCE: Historical live/replay experiment retained for reproducibility.
category_legend.SELF_CONTAINED_HISTORICAL: Historical bundle without an active consumer.
category_legend.RETIREMENT_CANDIDATE: Eligible for a separately reviewed future retirement; not deleted by C0.
category_legend.RETIRED: Removed from the active repository contract; byte-level provenance is recorded in the C1 retirement manifest and Git history.
